'''Cartha''', who attained the nickname of "'''Chaser'''," was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE pilot]] who served in [[Black Eight Squadron]] by [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]. Cartha would later transfer into the Imperial [[Black Squadron (Galactic Empire)/Legends|61st Squadron]] by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], ultimately participating in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], wherein the TIE [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].

==Biography==
[[File:TurrPhennirinROTJ.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Turr Phennir, Cartha's younger brother]]
Cartha was the older [[Gender/Legends|brother]] of [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]],<ref name="Turr-DSII" /> a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="X-wing 22">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 22|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 22]]</ref> who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in the [[Valahari sector/Legends|Valahari Provinces]] and raised by his [[Parent/Legends|stepfather]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Phennir (Count)|Phennir]], a renowned [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="AC10" /> By [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]],<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Cartha became a [[TIE pilot]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], flying fourth place in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Black Eight Squadron]] and attaining the nickname of "Chaser."<ref name="TFU" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|standard year]], Black Eight Squadron [[Bombing of Callos|bombed]]<ref name="Warfare" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Callos]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], who [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] Black Eight Squadron, was transferred out of the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] after Callos's bombing. Eclipse recommended Cartha to replace her in leading the squadron, although that position instead went to the pilot [[Redline]].<ref name="TFU" />

Less than a year after Eclipse's transfer out of Black Eight Squadron, Cartha remained flying fourth place in the squadron, under Redline's leadership.<ref name="TFU" /> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="SWE" /> Cartha had transferred to the Imperial [[Black Squadron (Galactic Empire)/Legends|61st Squadron]]. While serving in the 61st Squadron, Cartha participated in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="AC10" /> where Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] pilots attempted to defend the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During the battle, Cartha was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by<ref name="Turr-DSII" /> [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]]<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]],<ref name="Turr-DSII" /> and the Alliance's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] destroyed the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DS-3-12.jpg|thumb|right|270px|Paul R. Urquhart considered retconning Cartha as DS-61-4, whose TIE/LN starfighter, [[Black 4]], is shown in this image.]]
Cartha was first mentioned, albeit unnamed, in Turr Phennir's card for the [[2000]] ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="Turr-DSII" /> On [[August 19]], [[2008]],<ref name="Amazon">{{RandomHouseOld|url=catalog/display.pperl?isbn=9780345499028|text=Star Wars(r) The Force Unleashed}}</ref> a TIE pilot with the nickname of "Chaser" was mentioned in the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'',<ref name="TFU" /> which was released [[September 16]] the same year.<ref name="The Force Will Be Unleashed on September 16">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20080403.html|text=The Force Will Be Unleashed on September 16}}</ref> On [[July 29]], [[2014]], the tenth part of the [[StarWars.com]] article [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]] again referenced Cartha, naming the pilot and [[Retroactive continuity|retconning]] the character as having been "Chaser" from the ''Force Unleashed'' novel.<ref name="AC10" />

Although never published, author [[Paul R. Urquhart]]'s endnotes further intended for Cartha to be the character's surname and for Cartha to be Count Phennir's son and thus Turr Phennir's stepbrother. In stating his intentions to make Cartha the surname, Urquhart also noted that the name is shared with [[Uthorrferrell Cartha]],<ref name="Urquhart">{{JCFCite|url=posts/51719258|board=Literature|thread=The Official StarWars.com Blog Thread - That's right, I went there|user=[[Paul R. Urquhart|Thrawn McEwok]]|date=2014-07-30|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20151002203019/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-starwars-com-blog-thread-thats-right-i-went-there.50015309/page-46}}</ref> a native of the planet [[Eiattu 6]] who appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 13|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 13]],<ref name="TWP1">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 13|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 13]]</ref> published on [[November 27]], [[1996]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54658/star_wars_x-wing_rogue_squadron_1995_13|text=Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron (1995) #13}}</ref> He further intended to retcon Cartha as [[DS-61-4]],<ref name="Urquhart" /> a TIE pilot who was&mdash;like Cartha&mdash;killed by Wedge Antilles in the Battle of Yavin, an event specifically shown in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars''; Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" />
